steps.name: Mainland, eastern peninsula, and southern island painted
Editable project downloaded and structurally checked
Fresh-browser reopen preserves places and lore
Second download preserves every layer and object
steps.detail: Raster PNGs and item data match the first editable download

friction.name: Preview-only access
friction.evidence: The currently deployed VTT container does not serve this uncommitted map editor
friction.workaround: Use the local map editor preview with the VTT CSP; keep production untouched

friction.name: Reference legibility
friction.evidence: The reference is a phone screenshot with toolbar overlays and partly illegible place names
friction.workaround: Match the visible geography and readable names; record approximations

friction.name: Root-only test environment
friction.evidence: The prepared Playwright virtualenv is inside a root-only temporary directory
friction.workaround: Run the browser journey as root and restore admin ownership on proof artifacts afterward

friction.name: Proof-file permissions
friction.evidence: Files created in the root-run proof directory inherit root ownership and a restrictive umask
friction.workaround: Restore admin ownership and readable modes after the run

friction.name: Stamp variation default
friction.evidence: The stamp tool starts with slight random size/rotation variation enabled
friction.workaround: Turn it off in the visible controls for a repeatable reference journey

friction.name: Starter-map entry
friction.evidence: The editor first opens Die Silbermark rather than a blank canvas
friction.workaround: Use Datei → Neue Karte → Leere Karte before authoring

friction.name: Imprecise slider
friction.evidence: #brushSize: requested 180, first click got 170.0
friction.workaround: Adjust with the keyboard after the pointer click

friction.name: Large landmass by hand
friction.evidence: The visible brush tops out at 400 map pixels, so a continent outline needs many overlapping strokes and cleanup
friction.workaround: Use broad strokes, then smaller coastal strokes and eraser cuts

friction.name: Manual material targets
friction.evidence: Forest and rock material selection does not reliably choose a terrain layer
friction.workaround: Use the Layers tab to set Gelände before each material

friction.name: Raster river/road editing
friction.evidence: Fluss and Weg become raster paint; individual bends cannot be selected as path objects
friction.workaround: Keep river/road work on its dedicated layer and use Undo or eraser for corrections

friction.name: Imprecise slider
friction.evidence: #stampSize: requested 68, first click got 88.0
friction.workaround: Adjust with the keyboard after the pointer click

friction.name: Imprecise slider
friction.evidence: #stampSize: requested 102, first click got 88.0
friction.workaround: Adjust with the keyboard after the pointer click

friction.name: Imprecise slider
friction.evidence: #stampSize: requested 75, first click got 88.0
friction.workaround: Adjust with the keyboard after the pointer click

friction.name: Imprecise slider
friction.evidence: #stampSize: requested 74, first click got 88.0
friction.workaround: Adjust with the keyboard after the pointer click

friction.name: Symbol-by-symbol terrain
friction.evidence: Mountain ranges and forests require many individual stamp placements to resemble the dense reference
friction.workaround: Use repeatable seeded placement coordinates and the curated Kenney palette

friction.name: Unlinked town icons and places
friction.evidence: Settlement symbols and named places are separate objects positioned by eye
friction.workaround: Use fixed coordinates for both and inspect the exported image

friction.name: Separate file and painted titles
friction.evidence: The project title in the header does not draw a title onto the map
friction.workaround: Place TURTONIA as a separate text label

friction.name: Two export formats
friction.evidence: The PNG is a flattened image; editable layers, place data, and lore stay in the separate .rdmap.json download
friction.workaround: Save both files and explicitly test reopening the project

friction.name: Asynchronous import state
friction.evidence: An initial check of hidden loading overlay ran before the file import had begun, causing a false failure
friction.workaround: Wait for the imported title and lore in a fresh context

friction.name: Crowded symbol/label placement
friction.evidence: Mountain stamps and several names overlap in the exported image; the editor does not avoid collisions
friction.workaround: Record the screenshot for manual cartographic refinement

preview: local static editor with current VTT Content-Security-Policy
